title: Crispy Peruvian Chicken Flatbread
description: A fusion of Peruvian and Chinese flavors, crispy flatbread topped with sour chicken, fresh vibrant slaw, and a hint of cream.

ingredients.name: Peruvian chicken breast
ingredients.notes: Marinated in soy sauce and vinegar

ingredients.name: Vibrant cabbage slaw
ingredients.notes: Shredded cabbage with a hint of vinegar

instructions: 2. Marinate the Peruvian chicken breast in soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger for at least 30 minutes.
3. Bake the chicken in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through.
4. Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips.
5. Grill the flatbread for 2-3 minutes or until crispy.
6. Top the flatbread with the sour chicken, vibrant cabbage slaw, and a dollop of sour cream.
